observations: Torah #102 is a fragmentary record — the narrator states he did not merit to hear the full Torah that was said before the visiting rabbi. Only a brief summary of two bechina declarations was transmitted. The source text contains no additional bechina cluster of 3+ concepts forming an independent domain. The only concepts identified as explicit bechinot are: (1) בֹּעַז = גּוֹאֵל, and (2) רוּת = תְּפִלָּה. These four nodes are already fully captured in the two existing packages. The secondary paragraph about the Rebbe's revealed words containing all the worlds contains no bechina language and introduces no packageable concept cluster — it is a reflection by the narrator on the spiritual weight of the Rebbe's public teachings, not a structured bechina network. With only 4 nodes across 2 edges in a fragmentary teaching, there is no basis for proposing additional packages beyond the two already identified.
